project_objective: P(success | observable decision-time state, candidate action, candidate timing)

normalization_rules.numeric_types: Standardize integer/float representation. Do not scale before EDA.
normalization_rules.categoricals: Normalize whitespace/casing and inspect cardinality. Do not merge rare categories before EDA.
normalization_rules.timestamps: Parse timestamp/source fields consistently and derive temporal features. Do not use raw timestamps automatically as model features.
normalization_rules.monetary_units: Confirm amount fields are INR and use a consistent numeric representation.
normalization_rules.missing_values: Retain missingness for EDA. Decide on imputation only after analysing missingness.
normalization_rules.outliers: Do not remove or clip observations before EDA unless a structural validation proves they are invalid.
normalization_rules.identifiers: Preserve IDs for joins/grouped splits but exclude them from model X.
